message.content: {"caption":"Two-stage memory-guided question-answering workflow, showing memory construction and its use to generate answers.","description":"A rounded blue upper band is labeled “Stage 1: Memory Construction.” An icon of two people with speech bubbles, labeled “Dialogues,” points right to “Info Extraction,” then to “Search Memory Bank,” then to a blue “Memory Manager” container. The manager contains four stacked operation boxes: “ADD,” “UPDATE,” “DELETE,” and “NOOP.” A right-pointing arrow leads from it to “Memory bank constructed.” A rounded green lower band is labeled “Stage 2: Memory-Guided Answer Generation.” A question-and-speech-bubble icon labeled “Questions” points right to “Retrieve Memory,” then to “Memory Augmented Prompt,” then to a green “Answer Agent” container holding “Generation with Memory Distillation,” and then to “Answer.” Gray dashed connectors link the constructed memory bank with the Stage 2 retrieval and prompt area; the visible dashed routing includes an upward arrow into “Memory bank constructed” and a downward arrow into “Memory Augmented Prompt.” The solid workflow arrows point left to right. The diagram uses blue for memory construction and green for memory-guided answer generation; no checks or crosses are shown.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
